title: Nvidia and tech giants advocate open AI for cybersecurity
excerpt: Nvidia and dozens of tech firms form the Open Secure AI Alliance to advocate for open AI models as cyber defense tools after Hugging Face breach.
content_html:
Nvidia leads push for open AI cyber tools after Hugging Face hack

By Georgia Hennessy

You're currently following this author! Want to unfollow? Unsubscribe via the link in your email.

Nvidia and top tech companies have assembled a group calling for better support for open AI models to fend off cyberattacks in the wake of OpenAI's rogue agent hacking Hugging Face.

The Open Secure AI Alliance, unveiled Monday, comprises dozens of companies, including Microsoft, SpaceXAI, IBM, Palantir, Databricks, Dell, and Hugging Face itself, as well as the Linux Foundation and startups such as Cognition and Thinking Machines Lab.

In a blog post announcing the group, Nvidia called for regulators to recognize open models and security tooling as defensive assets rather than liabilities. Blanket restrictions would "weaken defensive capacity," it warned, and concentrate dependence on a few providers.

Critics view open models as a liability because their safeguards can be stripped out and their capabilities repurposed for attacks, a risk the post acknowledged but said was not unique to open systems.

Nvidia's post, which lists the companies as inaugural partners, also calls on governments and companies to fund shared open datasets, evaluation frameworks, and red-teaming tools. The group frames closed and open models as complementary.

"Attackers have frontier AI. Defenders need a frontier AI ecosystem—the best open and closed models, force-multiplied by a global community," Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang wrote in a Monday X post.

"During the Hugging Face incident, closed AI blocked essential forensics. An open-weight frontier model helped contain the intrusion. That's why we created the Open Secure AI Alliance," he added.

Hugging Face hacked

The announcement comes after Hugging Face said on July 16 that an AI agent had broken into its systems and stolen an access key. It said it used the key to reach deeper into the company's network. Five days later, OpenAI said that its models were responsible: GPT-5.6 Sol and a more capable pre-release system, both running with safety refusals dialed down for an internal test.

Hugging Face first tried to investigate the breach using commercial AI services, but analyzing the intrusion required submitting the attacker's own code. Closed tools, "unable to distinguish attackers from defenders," blocked the analysis, Nvidia said. The safety filters designed to stop hackers ended up hindering the hacked company instead.

Instead, Hugging Face ran an open model, Z.ai's GLM 5.2, on its own servers to review more than 17,000 actions. Defenders "need open, frontier agentic systems for self-defense," the Nvidia blog argued, or their response is constrained "at exactly the moment speed matters most."

Nvidia does not name OpenAI in the post, referring only to "closed AI tools." OpenAI is also absent from the membership list, along with Anthropic, Google, Meta, and Amazon. Z.ai, the Chinese developer of the model used by Hugging Face, is also not included.

content_html_zh:
Hugging Face 黑客攻击后，英伟达引领开放人工智能网络工具的发展

作者：Georgia Hennessy 您目前正在关注该作者！ 想要取消关注吗？ 通过电子邮件中的链接取消订阅。

在 OpenAI 的流氓代理黑客 Hugging Face 事件发生后，Nvidia 和顶尖科技公司组建了一个小组，呼吁更好地支持开放 AI 模型，以抵御网络攻击。

周一揭晓的开放安全人工智能联盟由数十家公司组成，包括微软、SpaceXAI、IBM、Palantir、Databricks、戴尔和 Hugging Face 本身，以及 Linux 基金会和 Cognition and Thinking Machines Lab 等初创公司。

在宣布成立该组织的博客文章中，英伟达呼吁监管机构将开放模型和安全工具视为防御性资产而不是负债。 它警告说，全面限制将“削弱防御能力”，并将集中依赖于少数供应商。

批评者认为开放模型是一种责任，因为它们的保护措施可以被取消，它们的功能可以被重新用于攻击，该帖子承认这种风险，但表示这并不是开放系统所独有的。

英伟达的帖子将这些公司列为首批合作伙伴，还呼吁政府和公司为共享的开放数据集、评估框架和红队工具提供资金。 该小组将封闭式和开放式模型视为互补。

“攻击者拥有前沿人工智能。 捍卫者需要一个前沿的人工智能生态系统——最好的开放和封闭模型，并通过全球社区进行力量倍增。”Nvidia 首席执行官黄仁勋在 Monday X 的帖子中写道。

“在抱脸事件中，封闭的人工智能阻碍了必要的取证。 开放权重边界模型有助于遏制入侵。 这就是我们创建开放安全人工智能联盟的原因。”他补充道。

拥抱脸被黑

Hugging Face 于 7 月 16 日表示，一名人工智能代理闯入其系统并窃取了访问密钥，随后宣布了这一消息。 该公司表示，它使用该密钥来更深入地了解该公司的网络。 五天后，OpenAI 表示其模型负有责任：GPT-5.6 Sol 和功能更强大的预发布系统，两者都在安全拒绝的情况下运行以进行内部测试。

Hugging Face 首先尝试使用商业人工智能服务来调查漏洞，但分析入侵需要提交攻击者自己的代码。 英伟达表示，封闭的工具“无法区分攻击者和防御者”，阻碍了分析。 旨在阻止黑客的安全过滤器最终却阻碍了被黑客攻击的公司。

相反，Hugging Face 在自己的服务器上运行开放模型 Z.ai 的 GLM 5.2，以审查 17,000 多个操作。 英伟达博客认为，防御者“需要开放的、前沿代理系统来进行自卫”，否则他们的反应“在速度最重要的时刻”会受到限制。

Nvidia 在帖子中没有提及 OpenAI，仅指“封闭的 AI 工具”。 OpenAI 以及 Anthropic、Google、Meta 和 Amazon 也没有出现在会员名单中。 Hugging Face 使用的模型的中国开发商 Z.ai 也不包括在内。
